delivery: Unreleased incremental source work. No version bump, commit, push, installer or installation.
scope: Strict portable data-only execution capability descriptor separates build, headless logic, window preview, window capture, offscreen render, embedded viewport and GPU compute declarations.
Trusted host-only adapter registry and generic frozen build/session orchestration separate engine process arguments, import phases, resource layout and cleanup into the Godot adapter.
Engine-neutral generated files, UUID resourceFiles, artifact identity and phase results are validated before destination publication; invalid paths, overlaps and silent failed phases are refused.
New build/session records bind an independent execution-adapter fingerprint; known Godot legacy records missing this field remain subject to historical generator, tool and byte checks.

Build workbench independently guards supported operations, platform, backend-owned jobs/artifacts and descriptor approval identity; Chinese/English/Japanese capability summaries preserve draft and diagnostic workflows.

windowRenderer: OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 26.0.8-1ubuntu0.3 - Compatibility - Using Device: AMD - AMD Radeon 680M (radeonsi, rembrandt, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.0.0-38-generic)

nativeBuilds.scope: Rust sources were unchanged this round. Existing native/WASM parity, archive and mobile-storage tests ran in the full app using supplied compiled native binaries; earlier standalone Rust test evidence retains its original scope.

harnessAndVerificationNotes: Initial real host run overlapped the last Godot adapter ownership-snapshot edit; the new fingerprint correctly rejected that changing adapter. The frozen final real host suite passed all 41 tests; host-real-initial-adapter-edit.log is retained.

Existing scene-edit UI fixtures lacked the now-required full backend descriptor and backend-owned jobs. Fixtures now represent actual transport data without removing assertions; ui-regression-first.log is retained.

Initial browser harness unconditionally clicked the editor toggle after diagnostic navigation had already entered editing. The corrected harness respects current editor state; initial browser evidence and log are retained.
The browser harness now defaults to a fresh temporary evidence directory and rejects non-empty explicitly selected output directories, preserving prior historical reports.
Initial pure-contract harness static scan matched a comment; corrected isolation checks still execute the actual module without Node or DOM. core-contract-initial.log is retained.
limits: Godot 4 on Linux remains the only product execution backend. The injected Node backend is a test fixture, not a new engine integration.
Current plan admission supports Scene2D plan versions 1 and 2 with runtime protocols 1 and 2. This is an internal trusted-host adapter contract, not a stable third-party plugin ABI.
offscreenRender, embeddedViewport and gpuCompute are explicit false; namespaced extension metadata does not execute GPU or native code. Nuislang, ns-nova, yalivia and Bevy are not implemented.
Mobile validation runs the prepared portable capability contract only. It does not provide an Android Godot executor or Android UI/device acceptance.
Tool availability retains the existing file/access check; engine identity and binary hashes are verified at actual build/run time.
This round verifies a real browser and graphical Godot preview, plus prepared desktop headless execution. It does not open or install a Tauri application.
